name: OpenSSL
summary: Find bugs in parsing, boundary checks and error handling.
description:
Investigate a specific defect in parsing, boundary checks, error handling, developer tools or test utilities. Prefer a narrow issue that you can understand and reproduce over a broad speculative audit. Check existing tasks and upstream reports before duplicating work.

Record the affected revision, build configuration, exact reproduction commands, and expected versus actual behavior. For a suspected memory-safety issue, include relevant sanitizer output from an isolated local run. A warning or suspicious code pattern alone is not a confirmed bug.

Prepare a minimal patch with a regression test that fails before the fix and passes afterward. Report which relevant tests passed and what remains unverified. Leave the changes ready for review; do not commit, push or open an upstream issue or pull request without authorization. Report sensitive security findings privately through the upstream disclosure process.
